The '''5th Critics' Choice Awards''' were presented on January 24, 2000, honoring the finest achievements of [[1999 in film|1999 filmmaking]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cnn.com/2000/SHOWBIZ/Movies/01/25/bfca.awards/index.html |title=Critic's Choice Awards echo Golden Globes |last=Clinton |first=Paul |publisher=[[CNN]] |date=January 25, 2000 |access-date=October 5, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bfca.org/ccawards/1999.php |title=The BFCA Critics' Choice Awards :: 1999 |publisher=[[Critics Choice Association|Broadcast Film Critics Association]] |access-date=October 5, 2021 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://archive.today/20120720061146/http://www.bfca.org/ccawards/1999.php |archive-date=July 20, 2012}}</ref>

==Top 10 films==
(in alphabetical order)

* ''[[American Beauty (1999 film)|American Beauty]]''
* ''[[Being John Malkovich]]''
* ''[[The Cider House Rules]]''
* ''[[The Green Mile (film)|The Green Mile]]''
* ''[[The Insider (film)|The Insider]]''
* ''[[Magnolia (film)|Magnolia]]''
* ''[[Man on the Moon (film)|Man on the Moon]]''
* ''[[The Sixth Sense]]''
* ''[[The Talented Mr. Ripley (film)|The Talented Mr. Ripley]]''
* ''[[Three Kings (1999 film)|Three Kings]]''

* '''Best Actor:'''
** [[Russell Crowe]] – ''[[The Insider (film)|The Insider]]''
* '''Best Actress:'''
** [[Hilary Swank]] – ''[[Boys Don't Cry (1999 film)|Boys Don't Cry]]''
* '''Best Animated Feature:'''
** ''[[Toy Story 2]]''
* '''Best Child Performer:'''
** [[Haley Joel Osment]] – ''[[The Sixth Sense]]''
* '''Best Composer:'''
** [[Gabriel Yared]] – ''[[The Talented Mr. Ripley (film)|The Talented Mr. Ripley]]''
* '''Best Director:'''
** [[Sam Mendes]] – ''[[American Beauty (1999 film)|American Beauty]]''
* '''Best Family Film:'''
** ''[[October Sky]]''
* '''Best Feature Documentary:'''
** ''[[Buena Vista Social Club (film)|Buena Vista Social Club]]''
* '''Best Foreign Language Film:'''
** ''[[All About My Mother|All About My Mother (Todo sobre mi madre)]]'' • [[Spain]]
* '''Best Picture:'''
** ''[[American Beauty (1999 film)|American Beauty]]''
* '''Best Picture Made For Television:'''
** ''[[RKO 281]]'' / ''[[Tuesdays with Morrie (film)|Tuesdays with Morrie]]'' '''(TIE)'''
* '''Best Screenplay – Adapted:'''
** ''[[The Green Mile (film)|The Green Mile]]'' – [[Frank Darabont]]
* '''Best Screenplay – Original:'''
** ''[[American Beauty (1999 film)|American Beauty]]'' – [[Alan Ball (screenwriter)|Alan Ball]]
* '''Best Song:'''
** "[[Music of My Heart]]" – ''[[Music of the Heart]]''
* '''Best Supporting Actor:'''
** [[Michael Clarke Duncan]] – ''[[The Green Mile (film)|The Green Mile]]''
* '''Best Supporting Actress:'''
** [[Angelina Jolie]] – ''[[Girl, Interrupted (film)|Girl, Interrupted]]''
* '''Breakthrough Performer:'''
** [[Spike Jonze]] – ''[[Being John Malkovich]]'' and ''[[Three Kings (1999 film)|Three Kings]]''
